title: smime-tree: fix ID_ENVELOPED_DATA local alias inconsistency and EcdhEs doc(hidden) on public variant
description: Two style items: (1) decrypt.rs:31 defines a local alias for rfc5911::ID_ENVELOPED_DATA; encrypt.rs uses it directly — pick one style and apply consistently; (2) key.rs:101 uses #[doc(hidden)] on a public variant of a public enum — change to pub(crate) if it is truly internal, or document it properly if it is intentionally public.
